objections.label: Overbroad time period
objections.description: The requested date range exceeds any reasonable connection to the claims.
objections.typical_support: Compare the range to the events at issue; propose a narrower window.

objections.label: Overbroad custodians
objections.description: More custodians are named than the facts plausibly implicate.
objections.typical_support: Identify custodians with documented involvement; offer the core set first.

objections.label: Unduly burdensome / disproportionate
objections.description: Cost and effort are disproportionate to the needs of the case.
objections.typical_support: Document collection estimates (hours, systems, vendor quotes).

objections.label: Personal / sensitive data
objections.description: Requests reach employee, patient, or customer personal data.
objections.typical_support: Offer redaction or a privacy-protective production protocol.

objections.label: Equally available from another source
objections.description: The same material is available from a party or public source at less burden.
